item.text: {"search_note":"I did **not** find strong 2024 evidence that Kishida used economic rule-setting for rent extraction, family favoritism, or clear business-partner patronage. I also did not find a clean direct source on property-rights reform or trade-policy distortion in 2024; the available evidence is mostly about wage policy, structural reform, labor markets, regional revitalization, and investment conditions.","evidence":[{"title":"Policy Speech to the 213th Session of the Diet","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office of Japan","date":"January 30, 2024","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202401/30shiseihoshin.html","summary":"Kishida said the economy is the foundation of public finances, called for restoring wage-led growth, and said Japan should move steadily toward fiscal soundness through expenditure reform.
